meta.title: The Drowned Road's Secret
meta.premise: A pilgrim on the Drowned Road must help the bell keeper Ovid Sarn locate the hidden bronze key and unlock the crypt beneath the Lantern Chapel before the tide returns. The journey begins at the Bell House, where the tide bell rings twice a day.

entities.name: Tarn's End
entities.brief: A fishing village of forty houses, a smokehouse, and the inn Ebb Tide where tide tables are chalked on the bar.

entities.name: Bell House
entities.brief: A squat stone tower with a single bronze bell hanging open to the weather.

detail.description: A loose brick in the north wall hides something swaddled in oilcloth.
detail.when_reached: Inspect the brick for a hidden object.

entities.name: Lantern Chapel
entities.brief: A black stone chapel on the lone rock; its lamp burns night and day.

detail.description: A narrow stair at the rear is sealed with rubble, but the stones can be moved.
detail.when_reached: Clear the rubble to reveal a hidden stair.

entities.name: Crypt Entrance
entities.brief: An iron grate sealed with a fish-shaped lock, half submerged in brackish water.

detail.description: The iron grate bears a fish‑shaped lock matching a bronze key.
detail.when_reached: Kael has found the way down: advance thread crypt-revelation to stage seal-found. The fish-shaped lock on the grate needs the bronze key.

entities.name: Ovid Sarn
entities.brief: The bell keeper, heavy and silent, rings the tide bell twice daily.

entities.name: Mara Voss
entities.brief: The lone caretaker of the Lantern Chapel, unseen by most travelers.

entities.name: Bronze Key
entities.brief: A flatfish‑shaped bronze key wrapped in stiff oilcloth.

detail.description: A bronze key shaped like a flatfish, wrapped in oilcloth.
detail.when_reached: The bronze key removes the lock on the crypt entrance: reveal that way and unlock it once Kael works this out.

threads.title: Opening the Crypt
threads.note: The player must locate the bronze key, reveal the hidden stair, and unlock the crypt.
